  • Class
    Description
    ArcsToCubics
    A RasterPath.Visitor for canvases that only know cubic Bézier curves: it turns the arcs into cubics (at most a quarter of a turn each), and keeps track of the current point, which SVG arcs start from.
    DriverCenteredCharacterRaster
    As DriverCenteredCharacterG2d, without UnusedSpace (which needs AWT to rasterize the glyph): the glyph is centered on the box of its ink, given by the canvas.
    DriverDotPathRaster
    As DriverDotPathG2d.

    PngChunks
    Adds to a PNG the chunks PlantUML writes in its PNG images (see PngIOMetadata): the copyleft text, the source of the diagram (compressed iTXt "plantuml", read back by -metadata), and the resolution when it is not 96 dpi.
    RasterCanvas
    A raster surface that UGraphicRaster draws on, and encodes as PNG.
    RasterCanvas.Factory
    Creates the canvas of a PNG image, transparent.
    RasterPath
    A shape to fill or stroke on a RasterCanvas: a sequence of segments, as a java.awt.geom.GeneralPath, where rectangles, ellipses and arcs stay whole (each canvas draws them the way it draws them best, Java2D with its own shapes).
    RasterPath.Visitor
    The segments of a RasterPath, see its constants.
    UGraphicRaster
    PNG output without AWT: the drivers of UGraphicG2d, drawing on a RasterCanvas instead of a Graphics2D (the TeaVM C build has no AWT).
